title: finding(pm,objectui): objectui's `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` has no LEVEL axis, so a `Clause-②: yes` PR with a `patch` changeset passes objectui CI
body:
Handoff-report item from the `domain:ui` seat 2 sign-off (objectstack-ai/objectui#9771), category **mechanizable**. Filed with `finding` only: `lanes/ui.md` says this seat writes no `domain:*`, type or grade, so routing to the skills lane is triage's call.

## What happened

Two contract reviews on this shift failed for the same reason:

- objectstack-ai/objectui#12312, review `6139743891`
- objectstack-ai/objectui#12315, review `6140680761`

Each PR declared `Clause-②: yes` but carried a `patch`-only changeset. CI was green on both, and only the isolated contract review caught it. Each cost one patch round.

## Measured

- objectstack's `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` has the LEVEL axis (objectstack-ai/objectstack#16055). It fails a `Clause-②: yes` PR whose changeset is below `minor`.
- objectui's file of the same name has no such axis. `git grep -n -i -E "level axis|clause" origin/main -- scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` returns 0 hits on objectui `866763b`. The same grep on objectstack `origin/main` is the control, and it does hit the axis header.
- No other objectui gate checks this level. `git grep -l -i -E "Clause-②.{0,80}minor|minor.{0,80}Clause-②" origin/main -- scripts .github AGENTS.md` returns 0 hits on objectui `866763b`.

## Dedupe

- objectui `search_issues` for "changeset level axis Clause-② yes requires minor bump objectui check-changeset-no-major": 11 hits, none about this gap.
- objectstack `search_issues` for "objectui changeset level axis clause-② minor port check-changeset-no-major": 32 hits. The nearest are objectstack-ai/objectstack#16055, #19548 and #19569, all closed and all about objectstack only.
